headline: Merger Subsidiary / AVANOS MEDICAL, INC.  (AVNS)  (CIK 0001606498)
body:
Merger Subsidiary filed a additional definitive proxy materials (Form DEFA14A) with the SEC on Jul 2, 2026, related to a proposed merger involving AVANOS MEDICAL, INC..

Form DEFA14A is required under Section 14 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
summary: Merger Subsidiary agreed to acquire AVANOS MEDICAL, INC. in a transaction. The merger requires shareholder approval following an SEC proxy filing on Jul 2, 2026.
